svg.title: 448 attention heads, one score form at a time
svg.desc: Relative error against Qwen3-0.6B's own attention scores, one prompt, every head. Each blue dot is one head at its exact-form relative error; layer 0 is at the top. Vertical markers compare all three medians: exact form, median 2.5 × 10⁻⁷; rotary left out, median 0.099; plain q·k, median 1.2.
